title: Phlur opens festive pop-up with Space NK to ‘build’ hype around Heavy Cream franchise
summary: Phlur has teamed up with the UK beauty retailer on a festive activation to promote the masstige fragrance brand’s new Heavy Cream Eau de Parfum and Heavy Cream Body Butter, alongside Space NK exclusive Cashmere Frost Hair & Body Mist
